text:
deploy-bot: HOLD: release/v1.13.5 -> prod
Reason: deploy-check mismatch: configmap `model-routing` content differs between staging and prod (selector keys).

mira: pausing rollout. assigning to infra-lee to triage.
tom: quick context: last week infra PR #3421 changed routing selectors to support multi-tenant prefixes; staging received the new configmap via the chart update but prod still has old selector keys.
sophie: can you paste the two configmap snippets?
infra-lee: staging configmap (excerpt):
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: model-routing
data:
  selector: tenant_prefix=true
  default_route: multi-tenant
```
prod configmap (excerpt):
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: model-routing
data:
  selector: tenantPrefix=true
  default_route: single-tenant
```
qa-raj: symptom: prod canary returned 404 for tenant-prefixed requests and fell back to single-tenant behavior. staging routed correctly.
mira: why didn't deploybot catch string key differences? it only compares presence of keys, not value canonicalization.
infra-lee: legacy charts used `tenantPrefix` camelCase; new chart uses `tenant_prefix`. helm migration included a note but the automated migration step was gated and not applied in prod because the release was marked "manual prompts required".
tom: risk: applying new config directly in prod could change default_route and impact steady traffic. safer path: rollback release and add a migration job that will transform existing configmap keys with a controlled window.
sophie: change window is in ~1h. recommendation: rollback to v1.13.4 to avoid inconsistent routing. then schedule an infra migration that: 1) create a migration job that copies `tenantPrefix` -> `tenant_prefix` and sets `default_route` to `multi-tenant` only after a dry-run flag, 2) add a deploybot check that compares both keys across envs, 3) update release notes and run a canary after migration.
qa-raj: I'll prepare a smoke test that hits tenant-prefixed paths and validates 200 responses and correct routing header.
mira: I'll pin the pipeline to v1.13.4 and open the rollback PR.
deploy-bot: Rollback requested by mira at 3311112260. Action: pin image to gcr/redwood/inference@sha256:9f8d7c6a, mark release/v1.13.5 as HOLD.
infra-lee: I'll draft migration PR to add a Helm post-renderer that performs key normalization during upgrade and include a migration job with a `--dry-run` flag. also adding a lint: warn if `tenantPrefix` exists in prod but not staging.
tom: add a small feature-flag guard so we can flip routing behavior after we verify migrations.
sophie: updating release notes: "Hold: model-routing key canonicalization required to ensure tenant routing parity between staging and prod." scheduling follow-up canary next Tue.
qa-raj: once rollback completes, I'll run the tenant-prefixed smoke and confirm fallback is intact.
mira: created INF-528: "model-routing key normalization + deploybot check" with links to rollback PR and migration PR. we'll reconvene after infra PR lands.
deploy-bot: Thread action: rollback complete at 3311112359. Please confirm QA checks before unholding.
qa-raj: acknowledged, running smoke now. will report results in this thread.
qa-raj: smoke result: prod fallback still working; tenant-prefixed test still 404 as expected pre-migration. marking as awaiting migration. :white_check_mark:
